address: 1 Club Row, Shoreditch, London, E1 6JX, United Kingdom
bio: To get to this delightfully fun little bistro, arrive at the busy Knave of Clubs pub in Shoreditch, where the team will whisk you up to the first floor via a secret stairway. Here, you’ll find a bright, welcoming restaurant where the counter is one of the best seats in the house – in part thanks to the utterly charming team who look after you every step of the way. The menu is packed with appealing dishes, from the generously sized pork schnitzel with mustard sauce and gorgonzola, to the playful rice pudding crème brûlée to finish....
